import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import build_plan, participant_distance, _deliver, Router, _candidate_orders, _adjacency, _decompose_trees
for f in ['fails_small_31.json','fails_big_32.json']:
    for (n, links, caps, parts, r) in json.load(open(f)):
        plist=[(v,r[v]) for v in parts]
        print('=== case', n, links, caps, parts, r)
        dist=participant_distance(n,links,plist,caps)
        names=[p[0] for p in plist]
        # try each origin, each order, report which fails
        for (v,rv) in plist:
            if rv<=0: continue
            router=Router(n,links,caps); recipes=[];memo={}
            outcomes=[]
            for order in _candidate_orders(v,[w for w in names if w!=v],dist,_adjacency(n,links,caps,plist)[0],set(names))[:6]:
                saved=list(router.res)
                res=_deliver(router,v,rv,order,names,n,dist,recipes,memo)
                if res is None:
                    outcomes.append('deliver-fail'); router.res=saved; continue
                recs=_decompose_trees(v,rv,res[0],plist)
                outcomes.append('ok' if recs else 'decomp-fail')
                router.res=saved
                if recs: break
            print('  origin',v,rv,outcomes[:6])
" 2>&1 | head -40
